blocks.text: NP-hard masle woh class hai jo NP (Non-deterministic Polynomial time) ke sab se mushkil maslon jitne, ya un se bhi zyada, mushkil hain. NP-hard masla hal karna mushkil hai, aur in ka hal dhoondne ka koi efficient algorithm maloom nahi. Yeh masle aam taur par bohat mushkil hote hain aur hal hone mein bohat waqt lete hain, chahe cases zyada bare na hon.
Misal: NP-hard masle ki mashhoor misal Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) hai, jo hum ne Section 3.3.2 mein parha.

items: No Known Efficient Solution (koi efficient hal maloom nahi): aisa koi algorithm maloom nahi jo bohat se shehron ke liye TSP jaldi hal kar de. Shehar barhne par mumkin raaston ki ginti factorially barhti hai, is liye masle ko bilkul sahi hal karna bohat hi mushkil ho jata hai.

Computational Complexity: TSP hal karne ka waqt shehron ki ginti ke saath itni tezi se barhta hai ke bare cases ka sahi hal nikalna asal mein mumkin nahi rehta. Maslan sirf 10 shehron ke liye 3,628,800 mumkin raaste hain.
20 shehar: taqreeban 2.43 x 10¹⁸ mumkin raaste (20!), jo bohat hi bari ginti hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar computer ek second mein ek arab (10⁹) raaste jaanche to 20 shehron ke tamam raaste jaanchne mein taqreeban kitna waqt lagega?
blocks.explanation: 2.43 x 10¹⁸ ÷ 10⁹ = 2.43 x 10⁹ seconds, yani taqreeban 77 saal. Is se pata chalta hai ke har raasta aazmana (brute force) kyun practically na-mumkin hai. (Ek arab raaste fi second hamara farz kiya hua andaza hai.)

blocks.text: Yeh program TSP ke tamam raaste ginta hai aur andaza lagata hai ke har raasta jaanchne mein kitna waqt lagega. cities ya checks_per_second badal kar Run karein (maslan cities = 10 ya 25).

import math

cities = 20
checks_per_second = 1000000000   # one billion routes checked every second

routes = math.factorial(cities)
seconds = routes / checks_per_second
years = seconds / (60 * 60 * 24 * 365)
print(cities, "cities:", routes, "possible routes")
print("Time:", seconds, "seconds, about", round(years, 1), "years")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import math": factorial ke liye.
"cities = 20": TSP mein shehron ki tadaad.
"checks_per_second = 1000000000": farz kiya ke computer ek second mein ek arab (billion) raaste jaanch leta hai.
"routes = math.factorial(cities)": 20! mumkin raaste.
"seconds = routes / checks_per_second": tamam raaste jaanchne ka waqt seconds mein.
"years = seconds / (60 * 60 * 24 * 365)": seconds ko saalon mein badalta hai (ek saal = 365 din).
Output: "20 cities: 2432902008176640000 possible routes" aur "Time: 2432902008.17664 seconds, about 77.1 years".
Khud try karein: cities = 10 kar ke Run karein: 3628800 raaste sirf 0.0036288 seconds mein ("about 0.0 years"); 10 se 20 shehar hote hi waqt 77 saal ho jata hai.

items: NP-hard: kam az kam NP ke sab se mushkil maslon jitna mushkil; koi efficient algorithm maloom nahi.
TSP raaste: 5 shehar 120, 10 shehar 3,628,800, 20 shehar taqreeban 2.43 x 10¹⁸.
